en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 137 - It is narrated from Maqanai from Bakkar bin Ahmad from Hasan bin Husain from Talid from Abu Jahaf [from Khalid bin Abdul Malik from Matar Warraq from Naji, that is Abu Siddiq from Abu Saeed Khudri] that he said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said: ‘Glad tidings to you, by the presence of Mahdi,’ and he repeated this statement thrice. ‘When he stages an uprising, people would be involved in discord and instability. He would fill the earth with justice and equity just as it would be fraught with injustice and oppression; and he would make people inclined to worship and his justice would encompass them.
